# Terraform Cloudflare Zero Trust

> Access applications and policies, Gateway policies, Cloudflared tunnels, device posture, and DLP.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [access-app](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/access-app): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/access-app`
- [access-policy](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/access-policy): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/access-policy`
- [device-posture](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/device-posture): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/device-posture`
- [dlp](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/dlp): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/dlp`
- [gateway-policy](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/gateway-policy): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/gateway-policy`
- [identity](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/identity): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/identity`
- [service-token](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/service-token): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/service-token`
- [tunnel](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zero-trust/tree/main/modules/tunnel): `terraform-cf-modules/zero-trust/cloudflare//modules/tunnel`
